description: Uploads a contact list (a spreadsheet or CSV) the way the Contacts page's Upload contact list does: names contacts Sergio already has by number only and adds the new ones. Send the file as content_text (a CSV/text file) or content_base64 (an .xlsx or any binary file) plus file_name. step preview writes nothing and returns the plan; step apply writes it (pass mapping as {field: columnIndex} when you have it, and only name or create to run one half). Every file is kept for the business. Naming the contacts' Quo cards and asking Sergio's team to organize the file stay a person's in the app. Nothing is sent to a client. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

content_base64.description: The file bytes, base64-encoded, for an .xlsx or other binary contact list.

content_text.description: The file text, for a CSV or plain-text contact list.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: upload_contact_list
title: Upload a contact list
